title: Energy-Code Window Schedule Pricing for Installation Jobs Permit Filings
content:
**Energy-code window schedule and the permit filing base — Installation Jobs**

The permit filing for a permitted **Installation Jobs** record carries an energy-code window schedule that lists every opening on the contract the job installs, and the length of that schedule decides how the filing base of the permit administration fee is priced.

The openings listed are:

- for a window job, the openings on the **Window Replacement Contracts** contract the job installs;
- for a door job, the units on the **Entry & Patio Door Contracts** contract the job installs.

## Pricing of the filing base

| Openings listed on the schedule | Filing base |
|---|---|
| more than 20 | 6.50 per opening listed |
| 13 to 20 | the method's permit administration fee plus 4.00 for each opening beyond the twelfth |
| 12 or fewer | the method's permit administration fee |

In the first row the per-opening price applies to every opening listed, and the method's permit administration fee does not enter the filing base. In the second row the 4.00 applies only to the openings beyond the twelfth.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, method fee figure 95.00)

| Openings listed | Filing base |
|---|---|
| 12 | 95.00 |
| 13 | 95.00 plus 4.00 for 1 opening, that is 99.00 |
| 20 | 95.00 plus 4.00 for 8 openings, that is 127.00 |
| 21 | 6.50 for each of 21 openings, that is 136.50 |
